about.title: About Us
about.intro: Welcome to Effet Coup de Cœur, your concierge service specialized in short-term rentals.
about.teamIntro: Behind this project, there is us: a team of two passionate people, each with their own universe.
about.teamTagline: Two complementary perspectives, one shared standard of excellence.
about.lauraDesc: A tourism enthusiast who understands the expectations of travelers and cares about the importance of every detail to transform a stay into a truly memorable experience.
about.remiDesc: A real estate lover, Rémi pays special attention to showcasing properties, the quality of spaces, and the care given to every home. His vision: reveal each place's potential with rigor and coherence.
about.portraitAlt: Rémi and Laura – Effet Coup de Cœur founders
about.teamDescription1: By combining our two passions, creating a concierge service became obvious: a service where the well-being of travelers and the management of your property meet.
about.teamDescription2: We put our expertise and passion at the service of your project, with special attention to every detail to create the Effet Coup de Cœur experience.
about.mission: Our mission: Create the Effet Coup de Cœur from arrival to departure.
about.travelers: We want our travelers to feel welcomed, reassured, pampered... and most importantly, to leave wanting to come back.
about.ownersDesc: We are here for you. To support you with confidence, relieve you and give you complete peace of mind.
about.valuesConclusion: are our core values in managing your property.
about.signature: Because your property deserves the best enhancement, and because your travelers deserve an experience that exceeds their expectations, we put our hearts into every detail.
about.signature2: This attention to detail, this rigor and the blend of our passions are what make the Effet Coup de Cœur signature.
about.teamSignature: The elegance of a place, the serenity of a service.
